title: Fundamentals of Data Structures
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called stable if it preserves the relative order of equal keys in the file."
A sorting algorithm is called stable if it preserves the relative order of equal keys in the file.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a namespace for organising classes and interfaces in a logical manner."
A package is a namespace for organising classes and interfaces in a logical manner.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a programming language model organised around "objects" rather than "actions" and data rather than logic."
Object-oriented programming (OOP) is a programming language model organised around "objects" rather than "actions" and data rather than logic.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to it as the "for loop" because of the way in which it repeatedly loops until a particular condition is satisfied."
Programmers often refer to it as the "for loop" because of the way in which it repeatedly loops until a particular condition is satisfied.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of assigning blocks of memory on request."
Memory allocation is the process of assigning blocks of memory on request.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a software bundle of related state and behaviour."
An object is a software bundle of related state and behaviour.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an example of an incremental algorithm; it builds the sorted sequence one number at a time."
Insertion sort is an example of an incremental algorithm; it builds the sorted sequence one number at a time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a group of zero or more statements between balanced braces and can be used anywhere a single statement is allowed."
A block is a group of zero or more statements between balanced braces and can be used anywhere a single statement is allowed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a blueprint or prototype from which objects are created."
A class is a blueprint or prototype from which objects are created.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the combination of two or more sorted sequences into a single sorted sequence."
Merging is the combination of two or more sorted sequences into a single sorted sequence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a word or sentence that is symmetric-it is spelled the same forward and backward, ignoring case and punctuation."
A palindrome is a word or sentence that is symmetric-it is spelled the same forward and backward, ignoring case and punctuation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as a finite step-by-step procedure to achieve a required result."
An algorithm can be defined as a finite step-by-step procedure to achieve a required result.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a field in computer science whose overall goal is an understanding of the complexity of algorithms."
Analysis of algorithms is a field in computer science whose overall goal is an understanding of the complexity of algorithms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used extensively at every level of a modern computer system."
Stacks are used extensively at every level of a modern computer system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a data structure in which the data items are chained (linked) in one direction."
A singly linked list is a data structure in which the data items are chained (linked) in one direction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called the rows of A, and the n vertical m-tuples, its columns."
The m horizontal n-tuples are called the rows of A, and the n vertical m-tuples, its columns.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an extremely well-known instance of divide-and- conquer paradigm."
Binary Search is an extremely well-known instance of divide-and- conquer paradigm.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sequential data structure, i.e. a collection of items accessible one after the other, beginning at the head and ending at the tail."
A list data structure is a sequential data structure, i.e. a collection of items accessible one after the other, beginning at the head and ending at the tail.

president

______ is used to invoke an object's method.
object reference

Selection sorting

means that MyClass

lineal chart

Say matrix A
Say matrix A is an m×p matrix and matrix B is a p×n matrix.

expression

______ is the most basic of all the control flow statements.
if-then statement
The if-then statement is the most basic of all the control flow statements.
______ is the implementation of an abstract data type in a particular programming language.
data structure
A data structure is the implementation of an abstract data type in a particular programming language.
______ are used to solve optimization problems.
Greedy algorithms
Greedy algorithms are used to solve optimization problems.
______ is a stage-wise search method suitable for optimisation problems whose solutions may be viewed as the result of a sequence of decisions.
Dynamic programming
Dynamic programming is a stage-wise search method suitable for optimisation problems whose solutions may be viewed as the result of a sequence of decisions.

mark-and-sweep algorithm

Before any array

best fit

frequently used metaphor

______ is a phenomenon that occurs in a long-running programme that has undergone garbage collection several times.
Fragmentation
Fragmentation is a phenomenon that occurs in a long-running programme that has undergone garbage collection several times.
______ is a contract between a class and the outside world.
interface
An interface is a contract between a class and the outside world.

preceding class declaration
